conditional_scope_of_inference: inference is conditional on cells and response rows within D_struct

domain_policy.not_uniquely_data_determined: D_struct is a policy choice, not the uniquely data-determined consequence of the source audit
domain_policy.primary: D_struct is the deliberate primary policy: high-coverage, provenance-safe, retaining all 28 predictors
domain_policy.sensitivity: any future full-domain fold-fitted missing-treatment analysis is sensitivity only; excluded cells and rows remain audit/sensitivity material

operational_estimand: species-specific relative response score over canonical cells in D_struct, conditional on the accepted presence/survey-supported-absence/pseudoabsence construction; not detection-corrected occupancy, abundance, population prevalence, or inference outside D_struct

pseudoabsence_post_domain.goal025_deferred: per-species and fold-level adequacy is deferred to Goal025
pseudoabsence_post_domain.preservation_rationale: Goal024 filtering is cell/predictor-only and preserves the >=3 same-cell support rule, the conservative >=5 km test against the full frozen presence set, provenance/precedence, and the absence of a quota/balancing/thinning contract
